title: Record each key's billing mode and what a call actually costs
goal: Give every key its billing mode - pay-as-you-go, subscription, free tier, prepaid balance - and derive the marginal cost of the next call from it: price per token for pay-as-you-go, zero until the cap for a subscription, a depleting balance for prepaid, and data plus rate cost for a free tier. A subscription must not appear infinitely cheap, and a prepaid balance must count down, or the router optimises the wrong quantity.
